payload.acceptance_criteria: When a record with no comment marker is stalled in the loop, the board shall emit its advance ask with requested_at taken from the record's last ledger event, and basicly board shall exit 0.
payload.description:
## Context
When a record reaches the loop with no comment marker, board_advance.asks emits an advance ask without requested_at, and test_an_undated_ask_carries_no_stamp_rather_than_this_instant pins that. The board snapshot schema requires requested_at on every ask, so basicly board exits 3 and test_mode_a_writes_the_page_and_the_contract_beside_it fails on the live ledger. It turned main CI red on e203ce77 after the lane C merge put basicly-9cv5p17 in intake; closing that record cleared the symptom only. Date the ask from the record's own last ledger event of any kind, not only comment markers.
payload.title: Date every advance ask so the board snapshot stays valid
